title: Skillfoundry Strategic Audit Report
description: The single deterministic contract every Skillfoundry gate conforms to. A consolidated report contains exactly three gate results plus a rollup. Every gate returns a 0-100 score, ranked reasons, and specific line-level rewrites.

title.description: Human label for the audited asset.

source.description: Optional path or URL the asset came from.

audited_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the audit run.

gates.description: Exactly the three Skillfoundry gates, in fixed order: relevance, performance, signal.

composite_score.description: Weighted mean of the three gate scores. Default weights: relevance 0.40, performance 0.35, signal 0.25.

ship_recommendation.description: SHIP if every gate PASSes; BLOCK if any gate BLOCKs; otherwise REVISE.

top_moves.description: The 3-5 highest-leverage changes across all gates, ranked. This is the answer to 'what do I do first'.

gate.description: Stable machine id for the gate.

framework.description: The public, cited framework this gate rests on.

score.description: 0-100. Computed from the gate's weighted sub-criteria, not assigned by vibe.

subscores.description: The weighted sub-criteria that produced the score. Present so the number is auditable.

ranked_reasons.description: Why the score is what it is, most important first. Each reason cites evidence from the asset.

finding.description: The specific problem or strength, stated plainly.

evidence.description: A short quote or location from the asset that grounds the finding.

rewrites.description: Line-level fixes, not vague prose. Each pairs the exact original text with a concrete replacement.

original.description: The exact span from the asset to replace.

rationale.description: Which rubric criterion the rewrite satisfies.
